# Pre-Market Brief, Tue Nov 10, 2026 (data as of ~7:50 AM ET, before CPI)

**Quiet, flat tape parked at yesterday's highs, waiting on 8:30 CPI.** As of ~7:35 (Yahoo), **ES 7578.5 (+0.06%)**, **NQ 27926 (−0.32%)**, **RTY 2849.7 (+0.04%)**. Overnight ranges are tight, and ES's overnight high (7598.75) sits right on the SPY 755 call wall / PDH equivalent. VIX is **20.2** (+0.3). Waller turned the screws at 4:00 AM: he'd back a December hike even if CPI improves, and said **50 bp may be needed if core prints 0.3% or higher** (consensus core +0.2%, headline +0.3%). Chips are soft (NVDA −1.1%, AMD −1.4%, AVGO −1.2%) as Anthropic launches its ~$1T IPO roadshow. It's not a Friday and not monthly OPEX (Nov 20). **All pre-market levels below are pre-CPI and will likely be rewritten at 8:30.**

Sources: Quant Data API on the user's account (GEX by strike, dark pool, 9k+ unconsolidated flow; pulled 7:47), Yahoo Finance (1m/2m/15m/5m/daily), the Financial Juice RSS feed, X (DeItaone, FirstSquawk, LiveSquawk, Team2Trading, X news), Digrin / TipRanks / ATLAS for earnings. Positioning came from the Quant Data API, not the browser My Pages tabs, and "magnets" are the largest GEX strike nodes plus dark-pool clusters. The prior-session 9k+ flow is from last night's close pull (207 rows).

## Positioning (Quant Data, session Nov 10, 7:47 AM snapshot)
The early book is thin and pre-CPI, so treat it as a starting map. The big change from last night: **SPY has flipped to slightly positive gamma**, QQQ is still short, IWM is flat.

- **SPY** (spot ~753.1):
  - **Net GEX:** **+0.31B** all expirations, **+0.14B** ex-0DTE (last night's carried book was −1.18B ex-0DTE). Cumulative flip only at 800 (far).
  - **Call walls:** **755 (+0.43B)**, 762 (+0.28B), **770 (+0.50B)**, 800 (+0.56B).
  - **Put nodes:** **735 (−0.48B)**, **744 (−0.33B)**, 750 (−0.22B), 733, 700.
  - **Sign changes:** **751–753** (spot is in this band); ex-0DTE 755, 759–760.
- **QQQ** (spot ~676.1):
  - **Net GEX:** **−1.04B** all, **−0.91B** ex-0DTE (from −2.63B ex-0DTE last night, shallower but still the short-gamma one).
  - **Put nodes:** **650 (−0.46B)**, **675 (−0.39B)**, **670 (−0.34B)**, 680 (−0.24B ex-0DTE), 665, 660.
  - **Call nodes:** **700 (+0.67B)** is the only big one, then 705, 695.
  - **Sign changes:** **679–681**, 685–686.
- **IWM** (spot ~282.6):
  - **Net GEX:** **+0.03B** all, about **0** ex-0DTE. Flat.
  - **Puts:** 275 (−0.11B), 265, **280 (−0.06B)**. **Calls:** **283 (+0.11B)**, 300 (+0.14B), 285–287 small.
  - **Sign change:** **283**.
- **Dark pool:** this morning's prints are tiny (≤$0.003B per level, clustered SPY 752.7–753.4, QQQ 676–677.9, IWM 282.3–282.7). Carryover from yesterday: **SPY 735.43 ($1.21B)** and 750–753 (~$0.5B); **QQQ 656.54 ($3.34B)** and **678.7–679.4 (~$1.5B)**; IWM 273.76 ($0.45B).
- **9,000+ pre-market prints (Nov 10):** **none** as of 7:47. Per the study, no big prints doesn't mean calm, especially into CPI.
- **9,000+ prints from the prior session (Mon Nov 9, 207 rows; structure read):**
  - **SPY:** 12:15 Nov 20 **710P 111k at the ask + 725P 103k at the bid**, both opening, with Nov 10 735P/710P legs: same sizes as Friday's OPEX structure, so the hedge was **adjusted, not abandoned**. 12:19 Nov 13 730P 55.6k and Nov 27 720P 22k at the bid: more **rolling of protection**. 12:08 Dec 775C 20k sold at the bid vs 800C closing: call overwrite rolled down. A far-OTM Nov 20 380/500/620 put fly was closed.
  - **QQQ:** 11:17 Nov 30 675P 14k above the ask, closing (short puts bought back). 12:21 Mar 2027 530P 25k at the ask (opening tail hedge). **15:56 Nov 13 660P 15k at the ask, opening: a fresh short-dated pre-CPI hedge.**
  - **IWM:** 15:39 **Dec 4 275P 30k at the ask, opening, vs Nov 20 267P closing**: puts rolled up with spot. Jun 2027 315C 12.5k at the ask, opening.
  - **NVDA:** Feb 2027 call spread rolled down (195/245 bought, 210/255 closed, 52.5k); Jan 140P 50k and Jun 2027 95P 75k sold below the bid: leaning into the dip.
  - **Read:** none of this is the "heavy put selling at the bid during deep negative GEX" snap-back template. It's **hedges rolled up and out after a trend day plus fresh short-dated QQQ puts into CPI**. In `/workspace/history`, short-dated put buying into an event tended to come before **whipsaws**, not clean trends.

Prior RTH (Mon Nov 9): SPY H/L/C **755.37 / 741.05 / 752.64**, QQQ **681.67 / 662.16 / 678.76**, IWM **283.75 / 276.84 / 282.49**. Futures equivalents use current ratios (ES ≈ 10.06× SPY, NQ ≈ 41.31× QQQ, RTY ≈ 10.08× IWM) and are **approximate**.

**SPY** (PM last **753.06** @ 7:45, inside yesterday's range, just above the PDC)
- PDH **755.37** (ES ~7602), PDL **741.05** (ES ~7458), PDC **752.64** (ES ~7575).
- PMH **755.31** @ 4:02 (ES ~7601; ONH 7598.75), PML **752.15** @ 4:10 (ES ~7570; ONL 7566).
- 15-min zones: **755.42** untested rejection (Mon 15:15, the high). Above that, **768.7–769.2** (Nov 4). No untested support pivot below within 3%.
- 2-min EMAs (13/48/200): **753.07 / 753.24 / 753.01**, **bunched: chop**.
- Confluence:
  - **755–755.4 (ES ~7598–7602): PDH, PMH, the 755 call wall, the untested 15-min rejection, and the ES overnight high. The key SPY level.**
  - **751–753 (ES ~7560–7580):** PDC, PML, the 751–753 sign changes, the EMAs and this morning's dark-pool prints. The intraday magnet.
  - **750 (ES ~7548):** put node and round number; **744 (ES ~7488)** put node next to yesterday's 744–746 sign band.
- Game plan: Break and hold **755.4** on a 15-min close, and calls toward **762**, then **770** (call wall); reject **755** and lose **750**, and puts toward **744** (put node), then the **741** PDL.

**QQQ** (PM last **676.06** @ 7:47, below the PDC, inside yesterday's range)
- PDH **681.67** (NQ ~28160), PDL **662.16** (NQ ~27354), PDC **678.76** (NQ ~28040).
- PMH **679.83** @ 4:01 (NQ ~28084; ONH 28109), PML **675.69** @ 4:10 (NQ ~27913; ONL 27869).
- 15-min zones: **681.70** untested rejection (Mon 15:15) and **674.18** untested support (Mon 11:30). Next resistance 695.38 (Nov 4).
- 2-min EMAs: **676.47 / 676.89 / 677.55**, a **bearish** stack (13 under 48 under 200), price under all three.
- Confluence:
  - **679.8–681.7 (NQ ~28084–28160): PMH, the 679–681 sign band, the 680 put node, the $1.5B dark-pool cluster at 678.7–679.4, the untested 15-min rejection and the PDH. The upside lid.**

- Game plan: Break **681.7** and calls toward **685–686** (sign band), with 700 (call wall) the bigger magnet; lose **674** and puts toward **670** (put node), then **662** (PDL).

**IWM** (PM last **282.58** @ 7:46, inside yesterday's range near the highs)
- PDH **283.75** (RTY ~2862), PDL **276.84** (RTY ~2792), PDC **282.49** (RTY ~2849).
- PMH **283.65** @ 4:01 (RTY ~2861; ONH 2860.7), PML **282.19** @ 4:10 (RTY ~2846; ONL 2844.2).
- 15-min zones: **283.71 / 283.79** untested rejections (Mon 15:15 / 14:30), then 284.69 (Nov 5) and 286.17 (Nov 4); **280.59** untested support (Mon 11:30).
- 2-min EMAs: **282.57 / 282.59 / 282.30**, **bunched: chop**.
- Confluence:
  - **283–283.8 (RTY ~2854–2862): the 283 call node and sign change, PMH, PDH, the untested 15-min rejections, and RTY's overnight high. The key IWM level.**
  - **280–280.6 (RTY ~2824–2830):** the 280 put node and the untested 15-min support.
- Game plan: Break **283.8** and calls toward **284.7**, then **286–287**; lose **282.2** (PML) and puts toward **280.6–280**, then the 276.8 PDL.

**Bias framing (Team2):**
- All three are opening **inside yesterday's range, just under the PDH**, so the PDHs (**755.4 / 681.7 / 283.8**) are the break-and-retest vs rejection levels. SPY and IWM's PDH lines up with the call walls, which makes them a natural lid unless broken with a 15-min close.
- The pre-market ranges are no-trade zones (currently SPY 752.2–755.3, QQQ 675.7–679.8, IWM 282.2–283.7), but **CPI will reset them**; re-mark the PMH/PML at 9:29.
- Wait for a **15-min body close** beyond a level, and **nothing before 9:45**.
- Casey hasn't posted a Tuesday game plan as of ~7:50 (his last post was a reply about memberships last night).
